Black Metal Ceremony
programme.desc: Immerse yourself in darkness with this collection of raw, atmospheric black metal. From blistering tremolo riffs to unholy vocals, this playlist evokes ancient rituals and nocturnal desolation. Enter the abyss and join the ceremony.

programme.title: Alternative Metal Paths
programme.desc: Break free from tradition with heavy riffs, crushing grooves, and genre-bending experiments. This collection showcases the boldest voices bridging alt-rock, grunge, and heavy metal into unvarnished, emotionally charged anthems.

programme.title: Heavy Pumping
programme.desc: Ditch the pre-workout and let the riffs do the heavy lifting. This high-octane blast of speed and power is designed to fuel your gains or ignite a living room mosh pit. High BPMs, crushing drums, and zero excuses.

programme.title: Power Metal Journey
programme.desc: Embark on a heroic quest fueled by soaring vocals, blistering guitar solos, and triumphant symphonic melodies. This playlist delivers high-energy anthems, epic fantasy tales, and pure, unstoppable speed metal glory.

programme.title: Metal Detector
programme.desc: Look no further! This is the right place for everything heavy. Your quest has ended so, lean back, turn up that sound system to a solid 11 and enjoy the ride. You have been warned…

programme.title: Death Metal Blasts
programme.desc: Brace for pure sonic devastation! Featuring relentless blast beats, guttural vocals, and razor-sharp riffs, this collection captures the raw intensity and uncompromising brutality of death metal at its absolute peak. Prepare for impact!

programme.title: Right Up Your Alley
programme.desc: As you found your way to our sophisticated TV channel, these music videos should hopefully satisfy your need for cool new Metal- & Rock content. Enjoy and let your friends know! Remember, we’re in this together.

programme.title: Symphonic Metal Epicness
programme.desc: Grand orchestral arrangements meet crushing heavy metal in a majestic display of power. Featuring operatic vocals, sweeping strings, and cinematic soundscapes, this collection delivers pure, dramatic drama on an epic scale.

programme.title: New Rock And Metal Videos For You
programme.desc: Stay ahead of the curve with the freshest drops from the global underground. From world premieres to the latest studio masterpieces, we’ve gathered the newest sonic assaults in one place. If it’s loud and new, it’s here.

programme.title: Gothic Metal Gathering
programme.desc: Step into the shadows with haunting melodies, heavy melancholic riffs, and dramatic symphonic arrangements. A dark, romantic journey through deep sorrow, eerie beauty, and powerful gothic soundscapes.

programme.title: Wishbone Ash - Live in London - 30th Anniversary Concert
programme.desc: Info not available

programme.title: Bay Area Godfathers
programme.desc: Info not available

programme.title: Bay Area Godfathers II
programme.desc: Info not available

programme.title: Night Time Metal
programme.desc: The sun is down, the filters are off, and the real chaos begins. Brace yourself for the raw, uncensored side of the scene too heavy for daylight. This is the unfiltered truth of the underground. Adult ears only.

programme.title: Where Heavy Music Lives
programme.desc: Your official gateway to the underground. Discover your first distorted riff or find a circle of peers who "get it." Welcome to the neighborhood—it’s loud, it’s proud, and there’s always room for one more.

programme.title: Progressive Metal Laboratory
programme.desc: A cerebral explosion of technical wizardry and complex structures. Dive into a fusion of dizzying riffs, odd time signatures, and soaring melodies as masters of their craft redefine metal's limits in this experimental sound lab.

programme.title: For Metalheads Only
programme.desc: Leave the rock anthems at the door—this is 100% pure steel. We’ve dialed the distortion to eleven for a lineup strictly for the heavy-duty fans. No compromises, no fillers, just total sonic devastation.

programme.title: Alternative Metal Paths
programme.desc: Break free from tradition with heavy riffs, crushing grooves, and genre-bending experiments. This collection showcases the boldest voices bridging alt-rock, grunge, and heavy metal into unvarnished, emotionally charged anthems.

programme.title: The Art of Destruction
programme.desc: Der Produzent Ilija Jelusic hat jahrelang die Band „Destruction“ begleitet.

programme.title: Finnish Metal Special
programme.desc: From the frozen North comes a sound of haunting melodies and raw intensity. Dive into Finland’s finest, where melancholic atmospheres meet the power of the thousand lakes. It’s a masterclass in darkness and ice-cold riffs.

programme.title: Folk Metal Forest Feast
programme.desc: Raise your horns and join the battle! A high-energy mix of crushing metal riffs, accordion melodies, and epic pagan chants. Step into the ancient woods for a wild night of acoustic tradition meets heavy metal fury.

programme.title: Your Pulse Of Metal
programme.desc: Sync your heartbeat to the complex rhythms of the underground. This collection dives into technical mastery and hidden gems that push your adrenaline. If you’re ready to feel the music in your veins, we’ve got the tracks.

programme.title: Manic Ritual
programme.desc: Lose yourself in the flickering shadows of distortion. A hypnotic sequence of sonic violence and dark imagery designed to unsettle the soul. Bow to the heavy. Welcome to the Manic Ritual.

programme.title: Thrash Metal Attack
programme.desc: Pure, unadulterated speed and fury! Experience blistering shred solos, aggressive riffing, and neck-snapping rhythms. Turn up the volume and brace yourself for an unstoppable wave of high-octane thrash metal chaos!

Follow along as Shahir prepares stuffed chicken with a berry reduction and puff pastry stars, melon caprese with a lemon basil vinaigrette, and jasmine and blackberry panna cotta!

programme.title: S01 : E10 Veneto - Bonacini's Italy

programme.title: S01 : E03 Brunch Brawl - VEGANnotvegan
programme.desc: Maddy and Kiki put a fresh spin on a beloved brunch staple, with homemade lox and bagels facing off against smoky carrot lox and high-protein bagels, all piled high with creamy spreads and classic toppings for a seriously satisfying spread.

programme.title: S02 : E04 Tuscany - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: The popular region of Tuscany is known for its wines, cheeses, and gorgeous sights. Chef Michael Bonacini introduces us to Tuscany's fine cuisine with four of his favourite dishes. Michael draws attention to the importance of mushrooms in Tuscan culture with an antipasto: Many Mushroom soup. Warm, hearty, and full of earthy flavour, Michael tops this soup with fried sage leaves to combine comfort and crunch in a single bite. For his primo, Michael explores a Tuscan favourite - Lamb Ragu! Served over pici noodles, Michael's rich ragu is complemented by fresh, light herbs. Then, Michael serves up a Porchetta-Style Duck, a crispy and tender secondo. To bring his meal together, Michael ends with a smooth and decadent Creamy Coffee Custard any coffee fan will appreciate.

programme.title: S02 : E01 Fresh Pasta - One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian chef and food guru Vanessa Gianfrancesco teaches us how to make fresh pasta like an Italian, and then uses that pasta to create everything from fettucine alfredo to tortelloni to lasagna bianca.

programme.title: S01 : E05 Olives and Onions - A is for Apple
programme.desc: After picking "O," Chef Robert Jewell makes French onion soup and olive chicken. Next he's challenged to use onions and olives in one awesome dish.

programme.title: S01 : E12 Fried Chicken Night - Spencer's Big 30
programme.desc: Nothing says comfort food better than fried chicken. Chef Spencer Watts shows us all the fixings for a fast, easy, and delicious fried chicken night.

programme.title: S02 : E20 Three course Argentinian meal - One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Award-winning chef Natalia Machado from Argentina makes palm heart and shrimp salad, beef stew in a pumpkin, roasted pork spare ribs with a delicious marinade, and addictive dulce de leche ice cream.

programme.title: S01 : E11 Comfort Food - Flour Power
programme.desc: Baking host Jessica McGovern warms up the kitchen with some melty, creamy, and chewy treats to comfort you on a rainy day.

programme.title: S01 : E09 Urban Eats - The Urban Vegetarian
programme.desc: Fa-what? Fa-waffles! Desiree Nielsen cooks up protein-rich falafel waffles for breakfast.

programme.title: S01 : E09 Grilled Cheese and Tomato Soup - Up the Dish
programme.desc: The ultimate childhood comfort food, Grilled Cheese and Tomato Soup! Missy Hui takes this dish up with a basil- infused tomato soup that's ubERS-creamy and fresh! Don't forget the grilled cheese - gooey Havarti, provolone, and cheddar ooze out of this sandwich for an ultra-indulgent dish. Tiera Singh's twist on toast and tomatoes? Panzanella Salad! Ripe, seasonal tomatoes are tossed with a tangy capERS-vinegar dressing that is soaked up by crunchy croutons. Going higher? Micah Trainor's Seared Halloumi and Glazed Fruit grills the cheese - no bread needed! Seared halloumi is topped with bourbon-glazed fruit for a savoury-sweet vegetarian dish. Poppy Sandler's Lobster Roll with Sweet Corn Bisque brings back the soup and sammie - Up the Dish style. Roasted corn cobs add a complex note, and homemade jalapeno mayo brings the spice!

programme.title: S01 : E10 Veal Piccata - Up the Dish
programme.desc: Up the Dish host Micah Trainor tries her hand at an Italian original - Veal Piccata! Lemony, buttery, capERS-y veal melts in the mouth after being pounded supERS-thin and seared to perfection. Poppy Sandler's sideways switch-up is a Caper Almond Crusted Halibut, sizzled and baked until gorgeously golden-brown and flaky, then garnished with chives and pea shoots. Next, Missy Hui goes Greek with her vegetarian Avgolemono, a silky-smooth citrusy soup starring lemon and egg, garnished with orzo and shimeji mushrooms. Tiera Singh ties it all together with her Sumac Veal Sweetbreads with a rough chopped caperberry-olive tapenade - browned veal sweetbreads are sprinkled with tart sumac and laid on a bed of tapenade, then drizzled with a sweet 'n' sour pomegranate molasses vinaigrette.

programme.title: S01 : E14 Paella - Up the Dish
programme.desc: In this episode of Up the Dish, steal away to Spain for a summer vacation as host Tiera Singh takes a swing at Paella, complete with sunny saffron, saucy sofrito, and super crunchy soccarat. Next, Missy Hui takes a break for brunch with Chorizo Eggs Benedict - the Saffron Hollandaise is good as gold and twice as bright! Poppy Sandler follows with her Fritto Misto and Sofrito, a delicate and fresh veggie fry-up that soaks up a tomato-spiked sofrito dipping sauce. Micah Trainor finishes up with restaurant-ready Razor Clams steamed in sparkling Spanish wine, served alongside nutty Iberico Ham and sweet Manchego cheese.

programme.desc: Vanessa plans an autumn-themed menu with a table to match! There's blood orange and broccolini salad, butternut squash mac ‘n’ cheese, cranberry-rosemary chicken thighs, sheet pan curried cauliflower, and so much more!

programme.title: S02 : E04 Achin' for Bacon - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: In this bacon loving episode, Chef Spencer delivers a tasty Bacon Weave Turkey Breast, which gets injected with beer and spices before being wrapped up in its cozy bacon blanket and sent off to the grill! Next up? A Peameal Bacon Roast with Rosti. This heavy hunk of back bacon gets smoked to flavourful perfection while Chef Watts makes the crispiest golden-fried-to-perfection potato pancake. Then, Spencer whips up a charry, grilled, super decadent, bacon-wrapped and bacon stuffed cheeseburger. Spencer isn't finished with bacon yet! For his final recipe, Spencer stuffs an apple with decadent crispy morsels stuffed along with savoury caramelized onions and melty cheddar cheese.

programme.title: S01 : E07 Fall - VegHeadz
programme.desc: Fall favourites are on display as chef Pino Di Cerbo shares magic autumn dishes. Beginning with Brussels sprouts, Pino serves them both roasted and fresh over creamy labneh with a funky black garlic dressing. Then, for a twist on regular risotto, Pino combines barley and celery to create a dish that is creamy and comforting. Autumn keeps falling in the next dish, a salad of butternuts, kale and a vibrant vinaigrette bursting with apple and ginger. For his fall finale, Pino creates mushrooms on toast with roasted mixed mushrooms in a rich sauce paired with gremolata and served hot on toasted focaccia!

programme.desc: Renowned Chef Michael Bonacini takes viewers on a culinary tour of the Italian region of Trentino-Alto Adige without leaving his own kitchen.

programme.title: S02 : E01 Basilicata - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: S02 : E02 Molise - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini highlights the tiny region of Molise, exposing some of its best kept savoury secrets. Starting with a classic, Michael cooks up a delicious multi-layered Chicory Timbale, a pie filled with fresh chicory, ripe roma tomatoes, and sliced prosciutto. To crisp up the top of the pie, Michael tops his delicious dish with finely grated pecorino cheese and crunchy breadcrumbs. Next up, Michael's primo is a spicy Octopus in Purgatory. This tender, colourful, and sumptuous dish is sure to impress in both looks and taste! For his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional Marinated Rabbit. Stewed in wine, tomatoes, and chilies, this rustic dish will have your guests asking for seconds. To finish, Michael whips up light and luscious Peaches and Cream Cookies. Filled with decadent cream, these round delights are refreshing and lighter-than-air - the perfect way to end a wholesome meal.

programme.title: S02 : E03 Valle D'Aosta - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Delving into the cold mountainous region of Valle D'Aosta, Celebrity chef Michael Bonacini whips up a meal of four hearty dishes that are sure to warm up any chilly day. First up is Michael's antipasto of Wild Mushrooms and Lardo on Rye. Coated with rich, earthy mushrooms, buttery fontina cheese, and savoury cured pork, this decadent dish highlights a combination of iconic flavours from Valle D'Aosta. Next up is a twist on traditional pasta with Valle D'Aosta's unique Chestnut Fettucine topped with Sweet Pork and Earthy Cabbage. The secret to this dish? Chestnut flour to create a denser, sweeter, and nuttier pasta. For his secondo, Michael turns to the pride of the region, Fontina cheese, to fill his Stuffed Veal Cutlets. Luscious and rich, this dish is a burst of luxurious flavours in every bite. For his final dish, Michael shows his sweet side with a Crema di Cogne served with Valdostana Tile Cookies. The thin, crispy cookies with a hint of hazelnut dipped in a light chocolate cream are the perfect way to wrap up Michael's luxurious Valle D'Aosta meal.

programme.title: S01 : E08 Thanksgiving - Holiday Eatz
programme.desc: Get your 'Gobble Gobble' on with this special episode of Holiday Eatz, featuring fun and charming host Kimberly Lallouz! She starts her terrific Turkey Day menu with a harvest happy Kale Salad heaped with beets, candied pecans, toasted lentils, and goat cheese. Thanksgiving dinner needs Hot Rolls, Chef Lallouz packs hers with cranberries and corn, then serves them as a standalone course with a cheesy, creamy Mushroom Fondue! Next, it's time to talk turkey with a trick that cuts your poultry cooking time in half! Her Spatchcock Turkey is not just faster than old school, it's yummier too, with a garlic-herb marinade and a unique side of mixed beans and rice! Candied sweet potatoes and marshmallows make their perennial appearance here, but Chef Kimberly has a version that will fry"... your brain! Check out her Sweet Potato Churros with Marshmallow Creme for a presentation you"... do-nut"... want to miss!

programme.title: S01 : E01 Spencer's Holiday BBQ - Spencer's Holiday BBQ
programme.desc: Join charismatic chef Spencer Watts at his glorious rooftop patio for a one-hour special featuring a full holiday spread, all made on the BBQ. Spencer’s festive menu is all about creative BBQ twists with his delectable, mouth-watering recipes including Burnt Orange Cranberry Marmalade, Maple Rye Pumpkin Pie, and Asparagus with Smoked Salmon Dip. Save room for the piece de Q-sistance: Smoked Turkey Two Ways. This year, take your holiday feast outside and serve up something deliciously different.

programme.title: S02 : E07 Sicily - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Simplicity is key with Sicilian cuisine and Chef Michael Bonacini explores just how the region balances simplicity with intensity through four flavourful dishes. Starting with an antipasto of Folded Flatbread with Ricotta and Fennel Seeds, Michael inspires with its intricate beauty with a simple recipe. Keeping to the theme of simplicity, Michael shows that plenty of flavour can come from little ingredients in his primo of Broccoli and Sausage Rigatoni. The spicy sausage and chili is countered by a creamy broccoli pesto for a dish that highlights Sicilian cuisine. Michael turns to the Italian queen of crops for his secondo: Eggplant Parmesan Roll-Ups. With thin slices of eggplant rolled up to contain a mouth-watering mixture of mozzarella, provolone, and pecorino romano, this dish gets an extra kick of flavour from a coating of breadcrumbs and tomato sauce. To bring it all together, Michael combines spicy with sweet through his tender Spiced Chocolate Cookies.

programme.title: S02 : E08 Lazio - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Filled with ruins in its bustling streets, the region of Lazio sticks with grandeur in all it does, including food! To introduce us to Lazio, Host Michael Bonacini highlights its Jewish influence with a crispy Roman Jewish-style Artichokes. As crunchy as a potato chip, Michael's artichokes are a delicious fried treat that are a perfect way to kick off a delicious meal. For his primo Michael brings together simple ingredients to create a rich Bucatini with Amatriciana Sauce. Michael's secondo turns what was once peasant food into a delectable and tender dish. Cooked with a blend of vegetables and sauce, Michael's Braised Oxtail brings forth the history of cuisine. Returning to Rome for his final dish, Michael cooks up the popular Sour Cherry and Ricotta Tart. With the tart cherries countered by the creamy ricotta, every decadent bite offers a world of taste.

programme.title: S02 : E09 Campania - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Campania's beautiful coastline is filled with two things: tourists and seafood. Diving into the culture of the region, Celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini begins his meal with a salad from the Island of Capri. Putting a twist on the classic dish, Michael's Grilled Caprese Salad combines fresh tomatoes, tangy balsamic, and a hint of sweetness from basil. For his primo, Michael serves up bold flavours with his Spaghetti Puttanesca. Mixing salty and sweet, this sauce offers a delicious take on the typical plate of spaghetti. Looking to the coast for his secondo, Michael quickly cooks up aromatic and spicy Herb-stuffed Scallops and Grilled Broccoli Rabe. For his dolce Michael whips up a dessert made for a celebration: Rum Babas. Typically for special occasions, each bite of Rum Babas offers pure sweetness with a fresh citrus zest.

programme.title: S02 : E10 Emilia Romagna - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini delves into the Italian region of Emilia- Romagna to discover its iconic cuisine. To start, Michael stays light with an airy Mortadella Mousse spread on fluffy Modena Mini Flatbreads. Next, Michael cooks up Tortellini in Broth, a dish originally from Bologna that can be easily altered to personal taste. Michael chooses to fill his tortellini with a rich and savoury mixture of prosciutto, mortadella, and ground pork. For his secondo, Michael uses traditional ingredients and pairs them in a tart, luxurious dish of Duck Breast with Balsamic Cherry Sauce. To wind down his meal, Michael whips up a creamy classic, Rice Custard Cake topped with a Cherry Glaze.

programme.title: S02 : E11 Calabria - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini explores sweet and spicy dishes hailing from the coastal region of Calabria. For his antipasto, Michael cooks up a light and refreshing Brioche with Gelato. Fluffy brioche buns surround the sweet flavours of gelato for a delicious start to your meal. Switching to spice for the primo, Michael introduces a Spicy Sausage and Ricotta Pasta. Full of sweet, savoury, and spicy flavours, this dish provides a strong, flavourful meal sure to please any crowd. For his secondo, Michael goes for a hearty Lamb au Gratin with Peas and Asparagus; a classic holiday dish that will warm any room. For his finale, Michael whips up a simple, yet impressive, Chocolate-covered Figs.

programme.title: S02 : E12 Lombardy - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Full of luxurious treats, the northern Italian region of Lombardy offers rich and delicious cuisine. For his antipasto, celebrity chef Michael Bonacini prepares a delicate dish of Stuffed Squash Blossoms. Soft and light, these blossoms are enhanced with a creamy filling of parmesan, anchovies, and nutmeg. Following the fresh taste of flowers, Michael cooks up an impressive and rich Risotto Milanese. A feast for your eyes and taste buds, this risotto is coloured by saffron and its floral strands release flavour and colour as it's cooked. For his secondo Michael pairs a succulent Veal Roast with the sweet and sour Mustard Fruit to bring out a tangy delight. Michael's dolce looks solely at chocolate, creating a creamy and crunchy Chocolate Salami. Full of nuts, cookies, and creamy chocolate, this rich dessert is a wonderful way to finish off any meal.

programme.title: S02 : E13 Umbria - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Known for its lush landscape, Umbria is a region of that offers fresh, seasonal ingredients perfect for simple yet boldly flavoured cuisine. To begin his Umbrian feast, Chef Michael Bonacini serves up a sweet and spicy antipasto of Fried Spicy Tomato Flatbread. Seasoned with chili peppers for that bit of heat, Michael's antipasto is a humble yet satisfying snack. For his primo, Michael brings our attention to an Umbrian specialty: truffles! Prepared with light and fluffy pasta, Michael's Gnocchi with Black Truffle concentrates the decadent flavour of the truffle in the pillowy pasta to create a rich and delectable dish. Paying homage to the plights of farmers and fisherman, Michael's secondo combines the delicious flavours of land and sea. Michael's seasoned Seared Fish is paired with sweet and savoury lentils for a warm and homey dish. Finally, for Michael's dolce he bakes a warm and wintery Umbrian classic: Umbrian strudel.

programme.title: S02 : E14 Sardegna - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Appreciating island culture, host Michael Bonacini explores the enchanting region of Sardegna and its exceptional cuisine. Michael begins his island feast with a taste of the sea through his seasoned antipasto of Stuffed Snails. Next, Michael prepares a luxurious and delicate Lobster Spaghetti, highlighting the fresh seafood of the region. Moving inland for his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional dish of Lamb with Artichokes and Saffron, a meal that combines three of Sardegna's most famous ingredients. To end his meal, Michael combines salty and sweet with a dolce of Honey and Cheese Fritters.

programme.title: S02 : E15 Friuli Venezia Guilia - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: One of Italy's quieter regions, Friuli Venezia Guilia offers iconic decadent dishes, waiting to be discovered. Renowned chef Michael Bonacini begins his exploration of the region with his take on a traditional meal: Cheese Crisp Baskets with Polenta and Mushrooms. This savoury antipasto is an elegant looking dish with humble flavours. For his primo, Michael prepares a unique Poppy Seed, Sage, and Prosciutto Pasta, a dish that is a twist on traditional pasta. Looking for a little heat in his secondo, Michael cooks up a meal of Spicy Tomato Scampi. The sweet meat of the scampi counters the heat of the sauce, creating a delicious flavour combination. To end his meal, Michael looks to the region's Austrian influence by preparing his dolce of Apricot Sweet Buns. Soft, sweet, and light these buns are the perfect way to wrap up a Friuli Venezia Guilia meal.

programme.desc: Renowned Chef Michael Bonacini takes viewers on a culinary tour of the Italian region of Trentino-Alto Adige without leaving his own kitchen.

programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: S02 : E02 Molise - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini highlights the tiny region of Molise, exposing some of its best kept savoury secrets. Starting with a classic, Michael cooks up a delicious multi-layered Chicory Timbale, a pie filled with fresh chicory, ripe roma tomatoes, and sliced prosciutto. To crisp up the top of the pie, Michael tops his delicious dish with finely grated pecorino cheese and crunchy breadcrumbs. Next up, Michael's primo is a spicy Octopus in Purgatory. This tender, colourful, and sumptuous dish is sure to impress in both looks and taste! For his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional Marinated Rabbit. Stewed in wine, tomatoes, and chilies, this rustic dish will have your guests asking for seconds. To finish, Michael whips up light and luscious Peaches and Cream Cookies. Filled with decadent cream, these round delights are refreshing and lighter-than-air - the perfect way to end a wholesome meal.

programme.title: S02 : E03 Valle D'Aosta - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Delving into the cold mountainous region of Valle D'Aosta, Celebrity chef Michael Bonacini whips up a meal of four hearty dishes that are sure to warm up any chilly day. First up is Michael's antipasto of Wild Mushrooms and Lardo on Rye. Coated with rich, earthy mushrooms, buttery fontina cheese, and savoury cured pork, this decadent dish highlights a combination of iconic flavours from Valle D'Aosta. Next up is a twist on traditional pasta with Valle D'Aosta's unique Chestnut Fettucine topped with Sweet Pork and Earthy Cabbage. The secret to this dish? Chestnut flour to create a denser, sweeter, and nuttier pasta. For his secondo, Michael turns to the pride of the region, Fontina cheese, to fill his Stuffed Veal Cutlets. Luscious and rich, this dish is a burst of luxurious flavours in every bite. For his final dish, Michael shows his sweet side with a Crema di Cogne served with Valdostana Tile Cookies. The thin, crispy cookies with a hint of hazelnut dipped in a light chocolate cream are the perfect way to wrap up Michael's luxurious Valle D'Aosta meal.

programme.title: S01 : E08 Thanksgiving - Holiday Eatz
programme.desc: Get your 'Gobble Gobble' on with this special episode of Holiday Eatz, featuring fun and charming host Kimberly Lallouz! She starts her terrific Turkey Day menu with a harvest happy Kale Salad heaped with beets, candied pecans, toasted lentils, and goat cheese. Thanksgiving dinner needs Hot Rolls, Chef Lallouz packs hers with cranberries and corn, then serves them as a standalone course with a cheesy, creamy Mushroom Fondue! Next, it's time to talk turkey with a trick that cuts your poultry cooking time in half! Her Spatchcock Turkey is not just faster than old school, it's yummier too, with a garlic-herb marinade and a unique side of mixed beans and rice! Candied sweet potatoes and marshmallows make their perennial appearance here, but Chef Kimberly has a version that will fry"... your brain! Check out her Sweet Potato Churros with Marshmallow Creme for a presentation you"... do-nut"... want to miss!

programme.title: S01 : E01 Spencer's Holiday BBQ - Spencer's Holiday BBQ
programme.desc: Join charismatic chef Spencer Watts at his glorious rooftop patio for a one-hour special featuring a full holiday spread, all made on the BBQ. Spencer’s festive menu is all about creative BBQ twists with his delectable, mouth-watering recipes including Burnt Orange Cranberry Marmalade, Maple Rye Pumpkin Pie, and Asparagus with Smoked Salmon Dip. Save room for the piece de Q-sistance: Smoked Turkey Two Ways. This year, take your holiday feast outside and serve up something deliciously different.

programme.title: S02 : E07 Sicily - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Simplicity is key with Sicilian cuisine and Chef Michael Bonacini explores just how the region balances simplicity with intensity through four flavourful dishes. Starting with an antipasto of Folded Flatbread with Ricotta and Fennel Seeds, Michael inspires with its intricate beauty with a simple recipe. Keeping to the theme of simplicity, Michael shows that plenty of flavour can come from little ingredients in his primo of Broccoli and Sausage Rigatoni. The spicy sausage and chili is countered by a creamy broccoli pesto for a dish that highlights Sicilian cuisine. Michael turns to the Italian queen of crops for his secondo: Eggplant Parmesan Roll-Ups. With thin slices of eggplant rolled up to contain a mouth-watering mixture of mozzarella, provolone, and pecorino romano, this dish gets an extra kick of flavour from a coating of breadcrumbs and tomato sauce. To bring it all together, Michael combines spicy with sweet through his tender Spiced Chocolate Cookies.

programme.title: S02 : E08 Lazio - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Filled with ruins in its bustling streets, the region of Lazio sticks with grandeur in all it does, including food! To introduce us to Lazio, Host Michael Bonacini highlights its Jewish influence with a crispy Roman Jewish-style Artichokes. As crunchy as a potato chip, Michael's artichokes are a delicious fried treat that are a perfect way to kick off a delicious meal. For his primo Michael brings together simple ingredients to create a rich Bucatini with Amatriciana Sauce. Michael's secondo turns what was once peasant food into a delectable and tender dish. Cooked with a blend of vegetables and sauce, Michael's Braised Oxtail brings forth the history of cuisine. Returning to Rome for his final dish, Michael cooks up the popular Sour Cherry and Ricotta Tart. With the tart cherries countered by the creamy ricotta, every decadent bite offers a world of taste.

programme.title: S02 : E09 Campania - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Campania's beautiful coastline is filled with two things: tourists and seafood. Diving into the culture of the region, Celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini begins his meal with a salad from the Island of Capri. Putting a twist on the classic dish, Michael's Grilled Caprese Salad combines fresh tomatoes, tangy balsamic, and a hint of sweetness from basil. For his primo, Michael serves up bold flavours with his Spaghetti Puttanesca. Mixing salty and sweet, this sauce offers a delicious take on the typical plate of spaghetti. Looking to the coast for his secondo, Michael quickly cooks up aromatic and spicy Herb-stuffed Scallops and Grilled Broccoli Rabe. For his dolce Michael whips up a dessert made for a celebration: Rum Babas. Typically for special occasions, each bite of Rum Babas offers pure sweetness with a fresh citrus zest.

programme.title: S02 : E10 Emilia Romagna - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini delves into the Italian region of Emilia- Romagna to discover its iconic cuisine. To start, Michael stays light with an airy Mortadella Mousse spread on fluffy Modena Mini Flatbreads. Next, Michael cooks up Tortellini in Broth, a dish originally from Bologna that can be easily altered to personal taste. Michael chooses to fill his tortellini with a rich and savoury mixture of prosciutto, mortadella, and ground pork. For his secondo, Michael uses traditional ingredients and pairs them in a tart, luxurious dish of Duck Breast with Balsamic Cherry Sauce. To wind down his meal, Michael whips up a creamy classic, Rice Custard Cake topped with a Cherry Glaze.

programme.title: S02 : E11 Calabria - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini explores sweet and spicy dishes hailing from the coastal region of Calabria. For his antipasto, Michael cooks up a light and refreshing Brioche with Gelato. Fluffy brioche buns surround the sweet flavours of gelato for a delicious start to your meal. Switching to spice for the primo, Michael introduces a Spicy Sausage and Ricotta Pasta. Full of sweet, savoury, and spicy flavours, this dish provides a strong, flavourful meal sure to please any crowd. For his secondo, Michael goes for a hearty Lamb au Gratin with Peas and Asparagus; a classic holiday dish that will warm any room. For his finale, Michael whips up a simple, yet impressive, Chocolate-covered Figs.

programme.title: S02 : E12 Lombardy - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Full of luxurious treats, the northern Italian region of Lombardy offers rich and delicious cuisine. For his antipasto, celebrity chef Michael Bonacini prepares a delicate dish of Stuffed Squash Blossoms. Soft and light, these blossoms are enhanced with a creamy filling of parmesan, anchovies, and nutmeg. Following the fresh taste of flowers, Michael cooks up an impressive and rich Risotto Milanese. A feast for your eyes and taste buds, this risotto is coloured by saffron and its floral strands release flavour and colour as it's cooked. For his secondo Michael pairs a succulent Veal Roast with the sweet and sour Mustard Fruit to bring out a tangy delight. Michael's dolce looks solely at chocolate, creating a creamy and crunchy Chocolate Salami. Full of nuts, cookies, and creamy chocolate, this rich dessert is a wonderful way to finish off any meal.

programme.title: S02 : E13 Umbria - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Known for its lush landscape, Umbria is a region of that offers fresh, seasonal ingredients perfect for simple yet boldly flavoured cuisine. To begin his Umbrian feast, Chef Michael Bonacini serves up a sweet and spicy antipasto of Fried Spicy Tomato Flatbread. Seasoned with chili peppers for that bit of heat, Michael's antipasto is a humble yet satisfying snack. For his primo, Michael brings our attention to an Umbrian specialty: truffles! Prepared with light and fluffy pasta, Michael's Gnocchi with Black Truffle concentrates the decadent flavour of the truffle in the pillowy pasta to create a rich and delectable dish. Paying homage to the plights of farmers and fisherman, Michael's secondo combines the delicious flavours of land and sea. Michael's seasoned Seared Fish is paired with sweet and savoury lentils for a warm and homey dish. Finally, for Michael's dolce he bakes a warm and wintery Umbrian classic: Umbrian strudel.

programme.title: S02 : E14 Sardegna - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Appreciating island culture, host Michael Bonacini explores the enchanting region of Sardegna and its exceptional cuisine. Michael begins his island feast with a taste of the sea through his seasoned antipasto of Stuffed Snails. Next, Michael prepares a luxurious and delicate Lobster Spaghetti, highlighting the fresh seafood of the region. Moving inland for his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional dish of Lamb with Artichokes and Saffron, a meal that combines three of Sardegna's most famous ingredients. To end his meal, Michael combines salty and sweet with a dolce of Honey and Cheese Fritters.

programme.title: S02 : E15 Friuli Venezia Guilia - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: One of Italy's quieter regions, Friuli Venezia Guilia offers iconic decadent dishes, waiting to be discovered. Renowned chef Michael Bonacini begins his exploration of the region with his take on a traditional meal: Cheese Crisp Baskets with Polenta and Mushrooms. This savoury antipasto is an elegant looking dish with humble flavours. For his primo, Michael prepares a unique Poppy Seed, Sage, and Prosciutto Pasta, a dish that is a twist on traditional pasta. Looking for a little heat in his secondo, Michael cooks up a meal of Spicy Tomato Scampi. The sweet meat of the scampi counters the heat of the sauce, creating a delicious flavour combination. To end his meal, Michael looks to the region's Austrian influence by preparing his dolce of Apricot Sweet Buns. Soft, sweet, and light these buns are the perfect way to wrap up a Friuli Venezia Guilia meal.

programme.title: S01 : E15 Trentino-Alto Adige - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Renowned Chef Michael Bonacini takes viewers on a culinary tour of the Italian region of Trentino-Alto Adige without leaving his own kitchen.

programme.title: S01 : E13 Ceviche - Up the Dish
programme.desc: Host Tiera Singh goes on a South American tour with Peruvian Ceviche. Marinated citrusy seabass and shrimp swim in a sea of sweet potatoes and creamy avocado - it's hard to beat! But Poppy Sandler takes a shot, and lands on Grilled Shrimp with a smoky charred Corn and Avocado salad, topped with garlic and lemon grilled jumbo shrimp. Next, Missy Hui indulges her sweet tooth with Vegan Key Lime Tarts. Her trick? Using avocado for extra cream and extra green. Branzino with Shishito and Mango is how Micah Trainor scales it up - her whole-fish-dish is pan-roasted and spiced with chaat masala, topped with mangoes and blistered shishito peppers for a five-star feast!

programme.title: S01 : E14 Paella - Up the Dish
programme.desc: In this episode of Up the Dish, steal away to Spain for a summer vacation as host Tiera Singh takes a swing at Paella, complete with sunny saffron, saucy sofrito, and super crunchy soccarat. Next, Missy Hui takes a break for brunch with Chorizo Eggs Benedict - the Saffron Hollandaise is good as gold and twice as bright! Poppy Sandler follows with her Fritto Misto and Sofrito, a delicate and fresh veggie fry-up that soaks up a tomato-spiked sofrito dipping sauce. Micah Trainor finishes up with restaurant-ready Razor Clams steamed in sparkling Spanish wine, served alongside nutty Iberico Ham and sweet Manchego cheese.

programme.title: S01 : E15 Coq au Vin - Up the Dish
programme.desc: Up the Dish goes French cuisine with Poppy Sandler's classic Coq au Vin! Slow-cooked chicken in a luscious red wine sauce with pearl onions and mushrooms on the side? Yes please! Tiera Singh sticks with the tricolour theme and makes a Salad Lyonnaise - crispy bacon, poached eggs, and homemade croutons, with a red wine-bacon vinaigrette that steals the show. Missy Hui stays on the continent but skips la Republique; her Vincotto Mushrooms with Lentils uses an Italian wine to sauce up meaty oyster mushrooms and aromatic vegetables for a vegetarian twist. But Micah Trainor takes us right back to France - her Rabbit Rillettes with Champagne Gelee is white tablecloth worthy, with rabbit confit cooked in duck fat and fresh berries in a sweet champagne gelee, too good to eat... almost!

programme.title: S01 : E16 Sashimi - Up the Dish
programme.desc: Get ready for a not-so-raw deal in this episode of Up the Dish! Host Poppy Sandler sets things in motion and slices up a simple, elegant Sashimi with tangy Ponzu and tart Wasabi Mayo on the side. Missy Hui gets carnivorous with Lamb Carpaccio and Dukkah - delicate raw lamb and a Middle Eastern-style dip served with some delicious pita! But wait, what's a vegetarian to do with all this meat? Tiera Singh's got the answer - island-style Poke Bowls, with fruit instead of fish. Refreshing watermelon is marinated in a savoury, soy-based sauce and served with rice. For the finale, Micah Trainor Up('s) the Dish with her Scallop Tartare and Beet Chips, combining raw scallops with ultra-decadent truffle oil and sour cream.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Italian Sweets - Flour Power
programme.desc: Host Jessica McGovern bakes up some delightful Italian classics including a crumbly Cherry-pistachio Biscotti.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Fancy French Flavours - Flour Power
programme.desc: Talented baker Jessica McGovern shows us how to get fancy with three stunning French desserts.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Eat your Fruits and Veggies - Flour Power
programme.desc: Don't forget to eat your fruits and veggies! Host Jessica McGovern shows us how to include nutritious ingredients into our decadent desserts.

programme.title: S01 : E04 Chewy, Chocolately - Flour Power
programme.desc: Host Jessica McGovern gives us a sweet taste of chocolate heaven with an overload of chocolatey desserts including a decadent Bombe au Chocolat.

programme.title: S06 : E01 Egg Episode with Chef Katie Ardington - Cook Like a Chef
programme.desc: Eggs are a perfect beginning for so many recipes and meals; Chef-host Katie Ardington is happy to "whisk" us along through a few of her favourites!

programme.title: S06 : E02 Tomato Episode with Chef Natalia Machado - Cook Like a Chef
programme.desc: Join our host, Chef Natalia Machado as she introduces us to her favourite techniques for using a wide variety of versatile, savoury tomatoes.

programme.title: S06 : E03 Duck Episode with Chef Craig Wong - Cook Like a Chef
programme.desc: Chef-host Craig Wong is our duck sherpa in this well-travelled episode of Cook Like a Chef"... first stop? Peking Duck!

programme.title: S06 : E04 Potato Episode with Chef Derek Dammann - Cook Like a Chef
programme.desc: In this episode, Chef Derek Dammann demonstrates talent and skills in demystifying the potato, using tons of terrific techniques"...

programme.title: S01 : E17 Fried Rice - Up the Dish
programme.desc: Take a trip around the world in this episode of Up the Dish! Host Missy Hui hits the Great Wall running - her Chinese Fried Rice recipe is a classic complete with crispy bacon, crunchy onions and savoury scallions. Then, Poppy Sandler sets off for the Land of the Rising Sun with Crispy Sushi Rice and Spicy Tuna; sriracha mayo seasons the sushi-grade tuna and sticky short-grain rice cakes are fried (fried rice anyone?) to a beautiful golden-brown. Micah Trainor's Gorgonzola-Chive Arancini puts a Sicilian spin on frying rice - panko-crusted arborio is creamy and flavourful with blue cheese and chives for this ultra-indulgent Italian redux. Rice Papad with Turkey Tikka Masala is Tiera Singh's Indian extravaganza, taken to the top with puffy (fried, of course!) rice papad and tender braised turkey legs drenched in old school tomato-spice curry.

programme.title: S01 : E18 Fennel Orange Salad - Up the Dish
programme.desc: Host Tiera Singh gets the show on the road with her Italian- inspired Fennel Orange Salad. Seared sushi-grade tuna rests on top of a crunchy, zesty, tangy fennel and orange salad with a honey-vinegar dressing to sweeten it up! Micah Trainor's revamp? Five Spice Duck a L'Orange with a sugary caramelized orange sauce and duck fat fried potatoes - is it French? Chinese? Who knows, but it's delicious! Next, Poppy Sandler pulls off a vegetarian variation, with a Roasted Veggie Bouillabaisse, complete with musky morels, umami-packed kombu, and tender asparagus. Missy Hui finishes up with her Orange Licorice Panna Cotta - aromatic orange blossom honey and licorice-like fennel pollen make the dish a decadent denouement to this episode of Up the Dish!

programme.title: S02 : E01 Portugal, Argentina, India, Japan - Global Veggies
programme.desc: Chef Pino Di Cerbo creates veggie dishes inspired by Portugal, Argentina, India, and Japan!

programme.title: S01 : E09 Indian Classics - One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Ever crave a delicious Indian feast? Host Vijaya Selvaraju cooks up Indian classics for a delightful family meal.

programme.title: S01 : E06 Papaya Salad, Carrot Hog Dogs, Squid, and Tofu - The Wizard of Whatever
programme.desc: Chef Kyle Crawford unveils four spellbinding dishes! First up, green papaya salad with crispy pork! Next, BBQ carrot hot dogs! Followed by grilled squid steak! Finishing with Korean BBQ tofu!

programme.title: S01 : E08 Summer - VegHeadz
programme.desc: Nothing screams summer more than salsa, especially chef Pino's sunshine yellow salsa served with grilled halloumi cheese. Yes, please! Next up, snappy snow peas pair with summer strawberries in a sprouted quinoa salad with Champagne vinaigrette! Pino then takes summer sunbathing to the next level, serving up blistered Shishito peppers and buttery radishes with sesame seeds and edible seaweed! For his final dish, Pino sums up summer with a French-style ratatouille served as a salad! Thinly sliced vegetables are lightly marinated before pairing with a fresh carrot purée in a dish that sparkles with summer.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Weeknight Dishes made in Little Thyme - Pressure's On
programme.desc: Who has "thyme" to make dinner after a hectic day? Host Vanessa Gianfrancesco inspires with four recipes including a Mushroom Thyme Risotto.

programme.title: S01 : E12 French Onion Soup - Up the Dish
programme.desc: Onions, cheese, bread, soup, four elements that live in harmony, especially in this episode of Up the Dish! Poppy Sandler starts off in Paris - classic French Onion Soup with sweet, caramelized onions and melty Comte cheese, with perfect rounds of toasted baguette. Poppy passes it over to Micah Trainor, who doesn't miss a beat; her Tenderloin Roast with Sherry Braised Shallots is sweet, savoury, and bursting with flavour. Tiera Singh takes a chive-y dive into the vegetarian side with her Chive Pesto Pasta - don't worry, the pesto is totally customizable! Missy Hui has the showstopper, Scallion Ash Carrots and Parsnips, and it's a five-star treatment that takes the simple to spectacular! Sous-vide carrots and turnips are sprinkled with sweet-savoury scallion ash for a strangely satisfying dish.

programme.title: S06 : E05 White Fish Episode with Chef Katie Ardington - Cook Like a Chef
programme.desc: Skilled Chef Katie Ardington is excited to introduce her favourite fish, striped sea bass, in this fabulous voyage through the 7 seas of seafood cookery.

programme.title: S06 : E06 Chicken Episode with Chef Natalia Machado - Cook Like a Chef
programme.desc: Chef-host Natalia Machado loves chicken, and who doesn't? Chicken is enjoyed around the world for good reason; it is versatile and reliably delicious!

programme.title: S06 : E07 Salad Episode with Chef Craig Wong - Cook Like a Chef
programme.desc: Salad is a wonderful addition to any meal, and sometimes even a meal on its own"... today, the talented Chef Craig Wong shares several of his superior salad ideas.

programme.title: S01 : E08 Thanksgiving - Holiday Eatz
programme.desc: Get your 'Gobble Gobble' on with this special episode of Holiday Eatz, featuring fun and charming host Kimberly Lallouz! She starts her terrific Turkey Day menu with a harvest happy Kale Salad heaped with beets, candied pecans, toasted lentils, and goat cheese. Thanksgiving dinner needs Hot Rolls, Chef Lallouz packs hers with cranberries and corn, then serves them as a standalone course with a cheesy, creamy Mushroom Fondue! Next, it's time to talk turkey with a trick that cuts your poultry cooking time in half! Her Spatchcock Turkey is not just faster than old school, it's yummier too, with a garlic-herb marinade and a unique side of mixed beans and rice! Candied sweet potatoes and marshmallows make their perennial appearance here, but Chef Kimberly has a version that will fry"... your brain! Check out her Sweet Potato Churros with Marshmallow Creme for a presentation you"... do-nut"... want to miss!

programme.title: S01 : E01 Spencer's Holiday BBQ - Spencer's Holiday BBQ
programme.desc: Join charismatic chef Spencer Watts at his glorious rooftop patio for a one-hour special featuring a full holiday spread, all made on the BBQ. Spencer’s festive menu is all about creative BBQ twists with his delectable, mouth-watering recipes including Burnt Orange Cranberry Marmalade, Maple Rye Pumpkin Pie, and Asparagus with Smoked Salmon Dip. Save room for the piece de Q-sistance: Smoked Turkey Two Ways. This year, take your holiday feast outside and serve up something deliciously different.

programme.desc: After picking the letter "L," Chef Robert Jewell takes on lamb and licorice in this ingredient challenge. He starts with aromatic Moroccan lamb riblets, an appetizer that will make you want this spicy dish as your main course too. Next, Robert takes it up a notch by showing us how to make licorice - yes, the candy! He brings coconut oil, brown sugar, creamed coconut, and molasses to boil before skillfully adding flour and anise to make sweet, chewy coconut licorice. Finally, Robert concocts the perfect recipe that combines succulent lamb with sweet licorice.

Concerto – OSN Gatti Bruckner Wagner Torino
programme.sub-title: Concerto – OSN Gatti Bruckner Wagner Torino
programme.desc: In January 2022, Daniele Gatti conducted the Orchestra Sinfonica Nazionale della Rai at the Turin Auditorium, performing Wagner’s "Parsifal" excerpts and Bruckner’s Symphony No. 9. The programme highlighted Wagner's meditative Prelude to Act III and Good Friday Spell, followed by Bruckner’s profound Ninth Symphony, marked by its emotional depth and unfinished final movement.

programme.title: Whats On Lights, Cinema, Mediterranean
programme.desc: The Mediterranean screens its stories this week. Malta hosts the Mediterranean Film Festival, while Italy Venice Film Festival and Med Film Festival bring glamour and regional storytelling to iconic locations. France Cannes Film Festival shines globally, Spain International Fantastic Film Festival of Catalonia celebrates genre cinema, and Morocco Amazigh Film Festival showcases North African voices. Turkey Adana Golden Boll Film Festival and Croatia Zagreb Film Festival round out a cinematic journey across the Med.

programme.title: Malini Angelica Lisbon
programme.desc: Malini Angelica explores Lisbon, the vibrant capital of Portugal. Once founded by the Phoenicians and shaped by Romans, Moors, and explorers of the Golden Age, Lisbon’s layered history is reflected in its culture and charm. During her visit, the city comes alive with the Festas Populares de Lisboa — a June celebration of Saint Anthony filled with music, dancing, and barbecued sardines. Malini samples local favorites like grilled sardines, bifanas, and the famous pastel de nata, and experiences the soulful beauty of Fado music. programme.sub-title: Whats On Conferences, Startups and Innovation
programme.desc: A new world is being built right now across the Mediterranean, and we are taking you behind the scenes of the most important meetings of the year. This week, we are at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for MedTech World, where the conversation has shifted from simple gadgets to responsible AI that doctors and patients can actually trust. We then head south to the incredible energy of AfricaIgnite to meet the founders of high-growth startups in climate tech and finance who are proving that Africa is the new engine of global innovation. Back on the islands, we explore the Startup Malta Festival to see how a pro-business ecosystem is helping entrepreneurs scale their boldest ideas across Europe. Finally, we join the global dialogue at the Finance Malta Conference to see how a focus on quality over quantity is redefining the future of investment and sustainability. This is a journey through the ideas and the people who are turning today's challenges into the success stories of the future.

programme.sub-title: Whats On Books Literature Innovation and Learning
programme.desc: Great ideas are the lifeblood of the Mediterranean and this week we are following them from the written page to the boardroom. We start at the Malta Book Festival, where the local community gathers to celebrate the stories that define the islands. Our journey then takes us to Cyprus for the Nicosia Book Fest to see how literature creates a unique bridge between cultures. In Spain, we wander the famous leafy avenues of the Madrid Book Fair, where Retiro Park becomes one of the largest outdoor libraries in the world. We wrap up at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for the EU Startup Summit, where the creative energy of storytelling meets the high-stakes world of global innovation. This is a look at the parks and the halls where the next chapter of the Mediterranean is being written.

programme.title: Med Minds 06 Jean de Valette
programme.desc: Jean Parisot de Valette, the steadfast Grand Master of Malta, led the Knights with courage, defended his island, and saved Europe as we know it.

programme.title: Mediterranean Yoga Slow Down and Breathe
programme.sub-title: Mediterranean Yoga Slow Down and Breathe
programme.desc: Mediterranean Yoga is a series that blends Embodiment Yoga with the peaceful beauty of the Mediterranean. Set in stunning coastal and natural locations, each episode encourages viewers to reconnect mind and body through gentle movement, breathwork, and mindfulness in a safe and calming space.

programme.title: Med Destinations Rimini
programme.desc: Med Destinations visits Rimini, Italy’s seaside gem, where golden beaches meet rich history. From Roman ruins to vibrant nightlife, Rimini offers the perfect mix of culture and coastal charm.

programme.title: S03:E09 French Riviera Uniquely Chic - Rick Steves Europe
programme.desc: Here along the Côte d’Azur, we wander the sunlit promenades of Nice, catch whispers of fortunes changing hands at Monaco’s famed casino, and step inside the elegant villas once home to artists and heiresses.

programme.title: Malini Angelica Sicily
programme.desc: Malini Angelica explores Sicily’s enchanting southeast, visiting Catania, Noto, Syracuse, and Ortigia. She dives into Catania’s lively fish market, samples local dishes like pasta alla norma and even horse meat burgers, and enjoys wine tasting in Noto’s vineyards. In Syracuse and Ortigia, she discovers stunning Greek ruins and seaside charm that showcase Sicily’s rich culture and history.

programme.title: S01:E02 1324 Mansa Musas Pilgrimage To Mecca - Dates that made history
programme.desc: Mansa Musa's Pilgrimage to Mecca explores the extraordinary journey of Mansa Musa, the emperor of Mali, to Mecca in 1324. Highlighting the wealth and power of the Mali Empire as Musa’s caravan traverses the Sahara, spreading wealth and religious influence. It examines the impact of his pilgrimage on both the Islamic world and Africa’s place in global history. Through this journey, Mansa Musa’s legacy of generosity and cultural exchange becomes legendary.

programme.title: Fadi Abou Rjeili Sirena
programme.desc: A heartfelt musical tribute to Malta, celebrating the island’s distinctive character, cultural heritage and enduring connection with its people. Set against the backdrop of the Mediterranean, this music video captures the beauty, spirit and identity of the Maltese Island.

programme.title: Malini Angelica Amalfi
programme.desc: Malini Angelica travels to Italy’s stunning Amalfi Coast, exploring its dramatic cliffs, colorful seaside towns, and crystal-clear waters. From the charm of Positano and Amalfi to the tranquility of Ravello, she experiences the region’s beauty, cuisine, and coastal lifestyle. Malini captures the magic that makes the Amalfi Coast one of Italy’s most breathtaking destinations.

programme.title: S01:E07 Greek Myths: Prometheus - The Rebel of Olympus - The Great Greek Myths
programme.desc: The tale of Prometheus, the Titan who defied Zeus by giving fire to humanity. His act of rebellion sparks divine punishment, as he is bound and tortured for eternity. Through striking imagery, the story reveals themes of sacrifice, defiance, and the price of progress.

programme.desc: En el Evason Ma'In Resort en Jordania, Jamie prueba los tratamientos de spa Srubis que aprovechan las propiedades curativas de las cercanas aguas termales de Hammamat Ma'In.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Guía XP Oslo 2, Noruega - Xp Guide
programme.desc: Quizás el período más famoso de la historia de Noruega fue la época vikinga. Lejos de ser simples invasores bárbaros y con hachas, los vikingos eran marinos nórdicos que dejaron un gran impacto en la historia europea a través del comercio, la colonización y la exploración remota. Durante la visita de Elisha a Oslo, queda asombrada por los extraordinarios y bien diseñados barcos vikingos en un museo, donde conoce historias fascinantes sobre la vida de los vikingos.

programme.title: S01 : E52 Guía XP Muscat - Xp Guide
programme.desc: Muscat, que se extiende a lo largo de casi 25 kilómetros a lo largo de la costa de Omán, combina el glamour del nuevo mundo y el encanto del viejo mundo para brindar a los visitantes una muestra de la verdadera Arabia.

programme.title: S01 : E07 Viajar Mexico Oaxaca - Viajar Mexico
programme.desc: Charlie presenta las artesanías indígenas de Oaxaca, incluidas las criaturas caprichosas con una historia única.

programme.title: S01 : E24 Espacios en la Ciudad Bikaner - City Breaks
programme.desc: Bikaner es conocida por la mayoría de la gente como la ciudad de los bocadillos salados de fama mundial. Sin embargo, cuando Asmita va allí para un viaje relámpago, descubre que hay mucho más en la Ciudad Roja de Rajasthan de lo que parece. Desde las pinturas en miniatura que se pueden encontrar en las paredes de palacios y mansiones de toda la ciudad hasta la elaborada arquitectura de los antiguos havelis de comerciantes, descubre que Bikaner es un paraíso para los amantes del arte.

Sin embargo, lo más destacado de su viaje es una sorpresa que le espera en un antiguo pozo escalonado.

programme.desc: Desde una ópera hasta palacios barrocos, las magníficas reliquias del pasado imperial de Viena tienen muchas historias que contar.

programme.desc: A través de aventuras como el paravelismo en Kavaratti y el buceo en Bangaram, Alex descubre la belleza de las islas de coral de Lakshadweep.

programme.title: S01 : E15 La Búsqueda Kolkata 2, India - Quest
programme.desc: Muchas colonias europeas compitieron por el dominio y la supremacía cultural en Bengala. Como resultado, su cocina absorbió muchas influencias occidentales.

programme.title: S01 : E05 Relajación Earl's Regency, Sri Lanka - Unwind
programme.desc: Indeya se relaja en Earl's Regency y explora sus aspectos espirituales y culturales. Visita un santuario de vida silvestre, prueba una comida tradicional y termina explorando los alrededores del lago Kandy.

programme.title: S01 : E21 La Búsqueda Fort Begu 1, India - Quest
programme.desc: Hambriento de historias y sabores de un reino pasado, Alex conoce a Rana Sawai Harisingh II, el 24º descendiente de la familia real Begu.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Spas del Mundo Kamalaya, Tailandia - World Spas
programme.desc: Ubicado en una hermosa ladera en Koh Samui, Tailandia, Kamalaya es un santuario de bienestar aislado con playa privada. Aquí, Jamie Srubis prueba una variedad de tratamientos de spa, como el tratamiento de envoltura y exfoliación corporal desintoxicante Swaadhika, que incluye una sesión de sauna de infrarrojos lejanos y un masaje de drenaje linfático. También prueba el yoga y el aeróbic acuático y luego disfruta de una comida desintoxicante.

programme.title: S01 : E18 La Búsqueda Karni Fort, India - Quest
programme.desc: Después de encontrar las recetas escritas a mano de sus abuelos, Vikramaditya Sodawas, el propietario de Karni Fort, decidió revivir las preciadas recetas de su familia.

programme.title: S01 : E12 Grandiosos Hoteles del Mundo Six Senses, Tailandia - Great World Hotels
programme.desc: Rodeado de aguas turquesas, playas vírgenes y exuberante vegetación tropical, Koh Samui ofrece a Elisha la combinación perfecta de serenidad y lujo.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Xplora Austria Innsbruck - Xplore Austria
programme.desc: En un viaje a Innsbruck, Eliseo descubre historias de un emperador del siglo XV, bajo cuyo reinado la ciudad alcanzó su apogeo.

programme.title: S01 : E18 La Búsqueda Naila 2, India - Quest
programme.desc: Khargosh es un plato olvidable ya que hay varios pasos para prepararlo y además lleva mucho tiempo.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Grandiosos Hoteles del Mundo Closenberg, Sri Lanka - Great World Hotels
programme.desc: Moeen, un entusiasta de los viajes, realiza una escapada corta al Hotel Closenberg en Galle, una ciudad amurallada holandesa del siglo XVIII en Sri Lanka con grandes casas coloniales y hermosas playas. En el resort, se topa con una boda tradicional de Sri Lanka, lo que le ofrece una idea de las tradiciones y la cocina del país.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Xplora Austria Salzburgo - Xplore Austria
programme.desc: Elisha está asombrado por la herencia musical de Salzburgo, que fue el escenario de las composiciones de Mozart y de la historia de la familia Von Trapp.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Fuera del Mapa Minicoy, India - Off The Grid
programme.desc: Alex se propone explorar los pueblos de la remota isla de Minicoy y termina en una fiesta local.

programme.title: S01 : E17 La Búsqueda Naila 1, India - Quest
programme.desc: Alex visita la ciudad rosa de Jaipur, India, para aprender otro par de platos olvidados. Recetas de Naila que hacen que el plato sea épico.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Xplora Austria Viena 2 - Xplore Austria
programme.desc: Elisha descubre el lado contemporáneo de Viena en algunos de sus barrios más modernos y animados.

programme.title: S01 : E16 La Búsqueda Calcuta 3, India - Quest
programme.desc: Alex conoce a algunos dueños de tiendas de dulces veteranos en Calcuta, quienes le enseñan a preparar dulces bengalíes olvidados.

programme.title: S01 : E17 Espacios en la Ciudad Múnich, Alemania - City Breaks
programme.desc: Desde palacios hasta museos, los edificios de Múnich son una mezcla fascinante de arquitectura tradicional bávara y diseño de vanguardia.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Xplora República Checa Kutná Hora - Xplore Czech Republic
programme.desc: La antigua ciudad minera de plata de Kutná Hora fue la segunda ciudad más importante del Reino medieval de Bohemia después de Praga. Rohan Patoley aprende sobre las antiguas glorias de la ciudad en la antigua casa de la moneda real, la corte italiana, y se sumerge en el romance de la pintoresca bodega Vinné Sklepy. También asiste al Royal Silvering Festival, una celebración gótica anual que recuerda el rico pasado de la ciudad.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Mochila El Cairo, Egipto - Backpack
programme.desc: La Mochila es la historia de un viajero solitario que emprende en una misión para descubrir la belleza, complejidad y carácter de diferentes lugares del mundo.

programme.title: S01 : E08 La Búsqueda Lucknow & Rewa - Quest
programme.desc: Dé un paseo por las calles de Lucknow y deléitese con una comida reconfortante y también descubra algunas recetas antiguas favoritas para compartir y conservar en este episodio de Quest.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Relajación Park Hyatt, Maldivas - Unwind
programme.desc: Indeya, se relaja en un lujoso resort isleño de las Maldivas. Al estar alojada en una villa con piscina, va a avistar delfines, hacer snorkel, practicar yoga y aprender una receta de pescado, para terminar con una cena al aire libre.

programme.title: S01 : E55 Guía XP Copenhague - Xp Guide
programme.desc: Elisha visita el parque de atracciones más antiguo del mundo: Tivoli Garden en Copenhague, que es la inspiración para Disneyland.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Espacios en la Ciudad Madrid, España - City Breaks
programme.desc: No hay mejor lugar para sentir el "duende", el espíritu y la pasión de España que su animada capital, Madrid. Alex capta algo de la contagiosa vivacidad de la ciudad en sus bulliciosas plazas como el Puerto del Sol y la Plaza Mayor. Experimenta el amor de los españoles por la comida mientras saborea auténticos churros españoles. También conoce la rica y compleja historia de la ciudad en lugares como la Catedral de la Almudena y el Palacio Real de Madrid.

programme.title: S01 : E14 La Búsqueda Calcuta 1, India - Quest
programme.desc: En Calcuta, Alex conoce a Rajiv Neogi y Siddhartha Bose, expertos gastronómicos que le presentan algunos de los platos olvidados de la cocina bengalí.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Spas del Mundo Fusión Maia, Vietnam - World Spas
programme.desc: Natural Living Massage, uno de los tratamientos exclusivos del complejo spa todo incluido Fusion Maia en Da Nang, Vietnam, es una combinación de curación oriental y aromaterapia. Jamie Srubis prueba esto junto con otros tratamientos como un masaje linfático tibio con bambú, que es bueno para desintoxicar, y Mindful Energy, un tratamiento de spa que combina reiki con una sesión de masaje de cabeza.

programme.title: S01 : E11 Guía XP Wayanad, India - Xp Guide
programme.desc: Wayanad, un pueblo bucólico de Kerala, ofrece un itinerario lleno de vida silvestre, ayurveda, plantaciones y spas.

programme.title: S01 : E13 La Búsqueda Shillong, India - Quest
programme.desc: Mientras cocina el pescado local de la región Jaintia de Meghalaya, Alex también se familiariza con la herencia culinaria de Sylhet en Bangladesh.

programme.title: S01 : E05 Xplora República Checa Praga - Xplore Czech Republic
programme.desc: Con un incomparable encanto del viejo mundo, Praga es la respuesta de la República Checa a París. Es considerada una de las ciudades más bellas del mundo. Rohan Patoley aprende sobre la historia y la arquitectura de esta fascinante ciudad en lugares como el majestuoso castillo de Praga, la plaza Wenceslao y un cementerio judío. Pero la mejor experiencia que tiene en Praga es cuando interactúa con el Palacio del Príncipe de Lobkowicz.

programme.title: S01 : E52 Mochila Ganja, Azerbaiyán - Backpack
programme.desc: Azerbaiyán tiene muchas maravillas naturales que podrían sorprender a un viajero. Desde volcanes de lodo físicos hasta impresionantes formaciones rocosas, Sabrina Chakici es testigo de algunos de ellos en el Parque Nacional de Gobustán. Después de esto, llega a la ciudad de Ganja, donde descubre la historia en lugares espectaculares como el Parque Heyder Aliyev, el Mausoleo Imamzadeh, la Mezquita Juma y el Mausoleo Nizami.

programme.title: S01 : E12 La Búsqueda Nagaland & Shillong, India - Quest
programme.desc: Desde la tradicional carne de cerdo ahumada en Nagaland hasta la carne de rana en Shillong, Alex descubre los secretos de la cocina tribal en Nagaland.

programme.title: S01 : E05 Grandiosos Hoteles del Mundo Four Seasons 2, Maldivas - Great World Hotels
programme.desc: Un vigorizante tratamiento de spa, una lección de cocina, una sesión de snorkel: Kim tiene experiencias en las Maldivas que la dejan completamente rejuvenecida.

programme.title: S01 : E07 Espacios en la Ciudad Budapest, Hungría - City Breaks
programme.desc: Desde la iglesia de San Matías hasta el Palacio Real, Catriona explora las atracciones icónicas de Budapest, "el París del Este".

programme.title: S01 : E06 Xplora Austria Viena 1 - Xplore Austria
programme.desc: Desde una ópera hasta palacios barrocos, las magníficas reliquias del pasado imperial de Viena tienen muchas historias que contar.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Fuera del Mapa Kavaratti, India - Off The Grid
programme.desc: A través de aventuras como el paravelismo en Kavaratti y el buceo en Bangaram, Alex descubre la belleza de las islas de coral de Lakshadweep.

programme.title: S01 : E15 La Búsqueda Kolkata 2, India - Quest
programme.desc: Muchas colonias europeas compitieron por el dominio y la supremacía cultural en Bengala. Como resultado, su cocina absorbió muchas influencias occidentales.

programme.title: S01 : E05 Relajación Earl's Regency, Sri Lanka - Unwind
programme.desc: Indeya se relaja en Earl's Regency y explora sus aspectos espirituales y culturales. Visita un santuario de vida silvestre, prueba una comida tradicional y termina explorando los alrededores del lago Kandy.

programme.title: S01 : E21 La Búsqueda Fort Begu 1, India - Quest
programme.desc: Hambriento de historias y sabores de un reino pasado, Alex conoce a Rana Sawai Harisingh II, el 24º descendiente de la familia real Begu.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Spas del Mundo Kamalaya, Tailandia - World Spas
programme.desc: Ubicado en una hermosa ladera en Koh Samui, Tailandia, Kamalaya es un santuario de bienestar aislado con playa privada. Aquí, Jamie Srubis prueba una variedad de tratamientos de spa, como el tratamiento de envoltura y exfoliación corporal desintoxicante Swaadhika, que incluye una sesión de sauna de infrarrojos lejanos y un masaje de drenaje linfático. También prueba el yoga y el aeróbic acuático y luego disfruta de una comida desintoxicante.

programme.title: S01 : E18 La Búsqueda Karni Fort, India - Quest
programme.desc: Después de encontrar las recetas escritas a mano de sus abuelos, Vikramaditya Sodawas, el propietario de Karni Fort, decidió revivir las preciadas recetas de su familia.

programme.title: S01 : E12 Grandiosos Hoteles del Mundo Six Senses, Tailandia - Great World Hotels
programme.desc: Rodeado de aguas turquesas, playas vírgenes y exuberante vegetación tropical, Koh Samui ofrece a Elisha la combinación perfecta de serenidad y lujo.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Xplora Austria Innsbruck - Xplore Austria
programme.desc: En un viaje a Innsbruck, Eliseo descubre historias de un emperador del siglo XV, bajo cuyo reinado la ciudad alcanzó su apogeo.

programme.title: S01 : E18 La Búsqueda Naila 2, India - Quest
programme.desc: Khargosh es un plato olvidable ya que hay varios pasos para prepararlo y además lleva mucho tiempo.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Grandiosos Hoteles del Mundo Closenberg, Sri Lanka - Great World Hotels
programme.desc: Moeen, un entusiasta de los viajes, realiza una escapada corta al Hotel Closenberg en Galle, una ciudad amurallada holandesa del siglo XVIII en Sri Lanka con grandes casas coloniales y hermosas playas. En el resort, se topa con una boda tradicional de Sri Lanka, lo que le ofrece una idea de las tradiciones y la cocina del país.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Xplora Austria Salzburgo - Xplore Austria
programme.desc: Elisha está asombrado por la herencia musical de Salzburgo, que fue el escenario de las composiciones de Mozart y de la historia de la familia Von Trapp.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Fuera del Mapa Minicoy, India - Off The Grid
programme.desc: Alex se propone explorar los pueblos de la remota isla de Minicoy y termina en una fiesta local.

programme.title: S01 : E17 La Búsqueda Naila 1, India - Quest
programme.desc: Alex visita la ciudad rosa de Jaipur, India, para aprender otro par de platos olvidados. Recetas de Naila que hacen que el plato sea épico.

programme.title: S01 : E18 Espacios en la Ciudad Frankfurt, Alemania - City Breaks
programme.desc: Machen Sie eine Pause von Ihrer alltäglichen Routine und entdecken Sie, was verschiedene Städte mit City Breaks zu bieten haben.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Xplora Irlanda Dublin - Xplore Ireland
programme.desc: Los pubs en Irlanda son mucho más que un lugar para beber; son una institución. Son puntos de acceso social, centros de encuentros culturales y diversión irlandesa. Olivia visita el pub más antiguo del país en Dublín, la capital, donde puede comprobar el amor que tienen los irlandeses por contar historias. Más tarde, va a la Guinness Storehouse para descubrir la historia detrás de la poción oscura, que no sólo es la cerveza más común en Irlanda, sino también una especie de símbolo nacional.

programme.title: S01 : E16 Mochila Yakarta y Jogjakarta, Indonesia - Backpack
programme.desc: Backpack ist die Geschichte eines Solo-Wanderers, der sich auf die Mission begibt, die Schönheit verschiedener Orte auf der Welt zu entdecken.

programme.title: S01 : E08 Viajar Mexico El Tule - Viajar Mexico
programme.desc: Charlie muestra las mejores formas de navegar por la vibrante escena culinaria de la capital gastronómica de México, Oaxaca.

programme.title: S01 : E09 Viajar Mexico Villa Del Carbon - Viajar Mexico
programme.desc: Desde la vegetación y la cultura hasta el poder espiritual, Charlie revela las cosas que hacen que algunos de los pueblos de México sean “Pueblo Mágicos”.

programme.title: S01 : E17 Espacios en la Ciudad Manchester - City Breaks
programme.desc: Sabrina Chakici visita Manchester, la ciudad del fútbol y la moda, la ciudad del patrimonio y el hedonismo, la ciudad de la revolución industrial.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Xplora Irlanda Galway - Xplore Ireland
programme.desc: Connemara, famosa por sus paisajes escarpados y lagos relucientes, es una de las regiones más románticas de Irlanda. En un viaje a este desierto rocoso, Olivia visita algunos de sus castillos perfectos para postales. En el idílico castillo de Ballynahinch, podrá experimentar la combinación perfecta de historia, lujo y belleza rural. También se siente profundamente conmovida por la historia de amor que dio origen a Kylemore Abbey, un fascinante castillo que parece la última página de un libro de cuento de hadas.

programme.title: S01 : E17 Mochila Monte Bromo y Parque Nacional Komodo, Indonesia - Backpack
programme.desc: Backpack ist die Geschichte eines Solo-Wanderers, der sich auf die Mission begibt, die Schönheit verschiedener Orte auf der Welt zu entdecken.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Xplora Irlanda Wild Atlantic Way - Xplore Ireland
programme.desc: La costa oeste de Irlanda, alguna vez considerada el fin del mundo conocido, es la parte más mágica de esta isla histórica. Olivia se embarca en un viaje a lo largo de la pintoresca ruta costera llamada Wild Atlantic Way, para explorar la belleza salvaje de esta costa escarpada con sus espectaculares acantilados, playas azotadas por el viento y aldeas bucólicas. En el camino se detiene en Burren, un paisaje lunar pedregoso de karst, donde ve los escarpados acantilados de Moher al borde del Atlántico en constante agitación.

programme.title: S01 : E10 Viajar Mexico Ciudad De Mexico - Viajar Mexico
programme.desc: Desde el reinado azteca hasta la Revolución Mexicana, la capital de México ofrece un vistazo a diferentes períodos de su historia.

programme.title: S01 : E18 Mochila Labuan Bajo y Bali, Indonesia - Backpack
programme.desc: Backpack ist die Geschichte eines Solo-Wanderers, der sich auf die Mission begibt, die Schönheit verschiedener Orte auf der Welt zu entdecken.

programme.title: S01 : E07 Grandiosos Hoteles Del Mundo Huvafen Fushi 1, Maldives - Great World Hotels
programme.desc: Un viaje a Maldivas es como un viaje a un gran paraíso de aguas azules. Una villa con piso, que ofrece vistas claras del océano turquesa y la exquisita vida marina bajo sus pies, realza esta experiencia para Kim durante su visita. Se mima aún más con un tratamiento de spa bajo el agua y una botella de vino de una bodega subterránea, que es como una cueva del tesoro para los conocedores del vino de todo el mundo.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Cronicas De Marruecos Chefchaouen - The Moroccan Chronicles
programme.desc: Rafe visita Chefchaouen y al instante queda enamorado de la ciudad, para gran confusión de los lugareños que están desconcertados por sus excentricidades.

programme.title: S01 : E04 Xplora Irlanda Belfast - Xplore Ireland
programme.desc: En abril de 1912, el RMS Titanic zarpó en su viaje inaugural a la ciudad de Nueva York y trágicamente se hundió en el Océano Atlántico Norte después de chocar contra un iceberg. Más de 100 años después, el orgulloso pueblo de Belfast continúa honrando la memoria de su “Reina del Océano” a través de su fantástica exposición, el Titanic Belfast. Olivia visita este espectáculo multimedia imperdible que hace que la historia del transatlántico más famoso del mundo cobre vida para ella.

programme.title: S01 : E08 Grandiosos Hoteles del Mundo Huvafen Fushi 2, Maldivas - Great World Hotels
programme.desc: Ya sea moderno o tradicional, soberbio o elegante, descubre los hoteles del mundo y como sobresalen ante los demás.

programme.title: S01 : E04 Mochila Bali, Indonesia - Backpack
programme.desc: Bali, un escondite tropical, logra ser un paraíso para los buscadores de aventuras, un santuario espiritual, un paraíso para los amantes de la comida y el retiro de un entusiasta de la naturaleza, todo al mismo tiempo. Esto es algo que Hannah Jackson descubre por sí misma mientras explora los templos de Bali, como el templo de Ulan Danu, prueba mariscos deliciosos y ultrafrescos, disfruta de algunas actividades de aventura como un paseo por el mar y visita un criadero de tortugas.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Cronicas De Marruecos Fez - The Moroccan Chronicles
programme.desc: La ciudad imperial de Fez, con sus atracciones ricamente evocadoras, hace que Rafe se sienta como si estuviera en una película... con un giro argumental a la vuelta de la esquina.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Besado por el Mar La Valeta - Kissed By The Sea
programme.desc: Begleiten Sie uns, wenn wir Ihnen von den Reisezielen erzählen, die ihr Leben neben dem salzigen Meer leben.

programme.title: S01 : E13 Herencia Mundial Noruega - World Heritage
programme.desc: Ya sean iglesias de madera, pueblos vikingos o fiordos espectaculares, el maravilloso patrimonio de Noruega revela su rica historia.

programme.title: S01 : E31 Guía XP Mauritius 1 - Xp Guide
programme.desc: Una guía exclusiva de cada país del mundo en términos de historia, comercio, gastronomía, vida nocturna, cultura y aventura.

programme.title: S01 : E32 Guía XP Mauritius 2 - Xp Guide
programme.desc: Una guía exclusiva de cada país del mundo en términos de historia, comercio, gastronomía, vida nocturna, cultura y aventura.

programme.title: S01 : E11 Spas del Mundo Kumarakom Lake - World Spas
programme.desc: Ubicado en las tranquilas orillas del lago Vembanad, Kumarakom Lake Resort está envuelto por la naturaleza y es reconocido como uno de los mejores complejos turísticos de lujo.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Besado por el Mar Comino - Kissed By The Sea
programme.desc: Begleiten Sie uns, wenn wir Ihnen von den Reisezielen erzählen, die ihr Leben neben dem salzigen Meer leben.
